items.name: theme
items.title: Facet UI theme
items.description: Facet UI colour, radius and motion tokens mapped onto shadcn variables (light + dark), plus the Facet corner utilities.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn() helper
items.description: Class name helper (clsx + tailwind-merge) used by every Facet component.

items.name: motion
items.title: Facet motion presets
items.description: Springs, easings and variants shared by every Facet component, plus <FacetMotion> for reduced-motion support.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Progressive disclosure: panels spring open to their natural height with a soft fade-in while the chevron rotates.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: Action Bar
items.description: A floating bulk-action bar that springs up when items are selected, with a ticking selection count and Escape to clear.

items.name: agenda
items.title: Agenda
items.description: A day-by-day list of events with times, colored category rails and a highlighted live event; days and events stagger in and rails grow.

items.name: ai
items.title: AI: Prompt Composer & Message
items.description: AI assistant panel: messages fade in, context chips animate and the send button morphs while a reply streams.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline, persistent message with a tone rail in four tones. Slides in as the rail draws and the icon pops, and collapses smoothly when dismissed.

items.name: app-layout
items.title: App Layout
items.description: A full app shell (sidebar, sticky navbar, main column, optional aside): the sidebar springs into an icon rail with a sliding active indicator, turns into a sliding sheet on narrow containers, and the aside animates its width in and out.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: Trend over time with a gradient fill; the area grows in on mount, a dashed crosshair and popping dot follow the pointer and the legend highlights a series.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Aspect-ratio box (Radix) for media with a soft reveal on load.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or workspace with image, tinted-initials fallback and presence dot. Images fade in, status dots spring, and groups stagger in and fan out on hover.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Short status or metadata label in nine tones. Text changes roll over while the width springs to fit, with an optional pulsing live dot.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Compares categories with grouped or stacked bars that grow in with a stagger; hovering a bar dims the others and the tooltip springs between values.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb & Pagination
items.description: Where you are and how to move through pages: crumbs slide in and collapse out as the path changes, and the current-page box glides between pages.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Chat bubbles with variants, start/end alignment and grouped corners that spring in from the sender's side, with popping reactions, link previews, actions and height-animated Show more.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins buttons, inputs and text addons into one control; text addons roll their value when it changes.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Spring press, ink ripple and a loading state that morphs the label.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid for picking a day or range, on react-day-picker. Months slide in the direction you navigate, the caption rolls and the selected day pops in with a spring.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Groups related content with the Facet cut. Interactive cards lift on hover and settle on press; cards animate in and out with AnimatePresence.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Drag or swipe slides with momentum, snap and animated pagination dots.

items.name: cell-color-picker
items.title: Cell Color Picker
items.description: Settings row with preset swatches and a custom colour input; the selection ring glides between swatches.

items.name: cell-select
items.title: Cell Select
items.description: Settings row with a compact right-aligned select; the value rolls on change and the menu pops in from the trigger.

items.name: cell-slider
items.title: Cell Slider
items.description: Settings row with a spring-counting formatted value and a full-width slider.

items.name: cell-switch
items.title: Cell Switch
items.description: Settings-list rows (group, label, icon tile) with a trailing switch; rows stagger in and the whole row toggles.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain Of Thought
items.description: Collapsible reasoning steps whose panel animates its height and whose status nodes morph from pending to a spinner to a drawn check.

items.name: chart-tooltip
items.title: Chart Tooltip
items.description: The floating value panel shared by every Facet chart (plus legend, formatting and number helpers); it pops in, slides its heading between points and springs the values.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Recharts container, tooltip and legend themed with the Facet chart palette. Series draw in when the chart scrolls into view, tooltips pop in and legend chips toggle series.

items.name: chat-attachment
items.title: Chat Attachment
items.description: File and image chips with type colours, a springy upload progress bar and remove; chips pop in and removed ones collapse.

items.name: chat-conversation
items.title: Chat Conversation
items.description: The chat scroll container: messages rise in, the view sticks to the bottom while replies stream and a jump-to-latest pill floats in when you scroll up.

items.name: chat-list-view
items.title: Chat List View
items.description: Sidebar chat threads grouped by date with a selection highlight that slides between rows, popping unread dots, a hover menu and collapsing deletes.

items.name: chat-loader
items.title: Chat Loader
items.description: Assistant waiting states: bouncing typing dots, a spinner with shimmering status text and a pulsing dot.

items.name: chat-message-actions
items.title: Chat Message Actions
items.description: Copy, rate and regenerate controls for an assistant reply; copy morphs to a check, thumbs pop and regenerate spins.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: A user or assistant message with avatar, meta and bubble variants; messages rise in on arrival and streamed words fade into place.

items.name: chat-source
items.title: Chat Source
items.description: Source chips that stagger in and inline numbered citations that pop a hover preview of the source.

items.name: chat-tool
items.title: Chat Tool
items.description: An agent tool call with a morphing status chip, height-animated input/output and an approval gate that collapses once decided.

items.name: checkbox-button-group
items.title: Checkbox Button Group
items.description: Card-style multi-select checkboxes that stagger in, lift on hover and glow with a drawn check when selected.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox and radio group; the checkmark draws itself in and the radio dot pops with a little overshoot.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip & Link
items.description: Filter chips that press with a bounce and draw a check when selected, removable chips that collapse out while neighbours slide in, and an underline-animated text link.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Lightly token-coloured code with filename, language tag, line numbers, sweeping line highlights and diff lines, plus a copy button that morphs to a check.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible (Radix) with height animation and a rotating chevron.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable combobox (cmdk) with filtering, multi-select chips that animate in and out.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K command palette on cmdk: scoped search, grouped results and a highlight that glides between items.

items.name: composed-chart
items.title: Composed Chart
items.description: Bars, lines and areas on shared or dual axes; bars grow, then lines draw in, with category dimming and an animated tooltip on hover.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu that pops out from the cursor, staggers its items, slides a highlight between them and draws checkmarks for checkable items.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: Spreadsheet-style grid with cell editing, animated row selection and live totals.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal for focused tasks: the scrim fades in while the panel springs up from slightly below and scales into place.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Actions in a floating menu that scales out of its trigger, staggers its items in and slides a signal-rail highlight between them.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: File upload target that lifts and glows on drag-over, with a staggered file list, springy progress and collapsing removal.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: Emoji picker with search, categories, skin tones and a live preview: the category indicator slides and follows the scroll, search results re-flow with layout animations, and the picked emoji pops and floats up.

items.name: emoji-reaction
items.title: Emoji Reaction Button
items.description: Reaction pills that burst on click and tick their counts up.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Explains why a view is empty and what to do next. Content staggers in on view, the icon pops in and floats gently on hover.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label + control + help text wired with aria-describedby; the error message slides in and collapses away.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: Expandable file tree: folders open with height animation and rotating chevrons; full keyboard support.

items.name: floating-toc
items.title: Floating TOC
items.description: Floating table of contents: compact bars that expand into a panel, with an active marker that follows the scroll.

items.name: holo-card
items.title: Holo Card
items.description: Membership or credit card that tilts toward the pointer with a moving holographic sheen.

items.name: inline-select
items.title: Inline Select
items.description: Inline select inside a sentence: the value swaps with a roll and the menu pops from the word.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Inputs with prefixes, suffixes, icons and buttons; addons animate on focus and reveal.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code input; digits pop into their slots, wrong codes shake and a correct code ripples green.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text input with leading/trailing addons, a fading focus ring, a brand underline sweep and an invalid shake.

items.name: item-card-group
items.title: Item Card Group
items.description: Arranges item cards as a spaced list, a joined list with dividers or a responsive grid; cards stagger in and spring on press.

items.name: item-card
items.title: Item Card
items.description: A horizontal row card with icon, title, description and trailing action, in five surface styles. Groups stagger in; pressable cards tint, settle on press and nudge their chevron.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: Board columns with draggable task cards; cards lift and tilt while dragged, a drop line marks the target, neighbours shift with layout animations and keyboard moves (Space, arrows) are announced.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd, Spinner, Skeleton, Separator
items.description: Small utilities: keycaps that press in when the real key is held, a breathing arc spinner, shimmering skeletons and a separator that draws in.

items.name: kpi-group
items.title: KPI Group
items.description: Several KPIs joined into one card with shared dividers that wraps responsively. Metrics stagger in on view, values tick on change and cells tint on hover.

items.name: kpi
items.title: KPI
items.description: A key number with label, trend chip and optional sparkline, progress or footer. Values count up with a spring, trends pop in and flip, sparklines draw in and progress springs to its value.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label with required/optional markers that animate as the form's rules change.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: One or more series over time, with dashed targets and optional dots; lines draw in on mount and the legend fades the other series on hover.

items.name: list-view
items.title: List View
items.description: A selectable list of rows with avatar, two lines of text and metadata; rows stagger in and the selection rail slides between rows.

items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: Stylised map with animated pins, a drawn route, zoom controls and pop-in details — no map library.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Renders a safe Markdown subset (headings, lists, tasks, quotes, code, tables, links) as Facet prose without injecting HTML; blocks rise in as they stream.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Conversation separators and status notes (date breaks, joins, New messages, summaries) whose rules draw outward as the label fades in.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A desktop-style menu bar whose open-menu pill slides between triggers while panels scale in, stagger their items and slide a highlight between them.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Conversation scroll container that sticks to the bottom while replies stream, anchors new turns, restores history without jumping, tracks seen messages and floats in a jump-to-latest pill with a popping unread count.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: Styled native <select> with an animated chevron and an error shake.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: A sticky, blurred top bar: a highlight follows the pointer across links, the active marker slides between pages, and under 720px the menu icon morphs and the mobile menu springs open with staggered links.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with rich dropdown panels: a highlight slides between triggers, the shared panel pops in, resizes smoothly between items and slides its content in from the direction you moved.

items.name: number-stepper
items.title: Number Stepper
items.description: Number stepper whose digits roll on change; hold to repeat with acceleration.

items.name: number-value
items.title: Number Value
items.description: Formats numbers with Intl (currency, compact, percent, signed); digits roll like an odometer when the value changes.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: Donut or pie with a percentage legend; slices sweep in, spring outward on hover and the center total counts up and swaps to the hovered slice.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover, Hover Card & Tooltip
items.description: Lightweight floating surfaces that spring out of their trigger side and fade away on close.

items.name: pressable
items.title: Pressable Feedback
items.description: Press feedback wrapper — scale, highlight or lift — for any card or tile.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing Card
items.description: Plan comparison card whose price rolls digit-by-digit on billing changes; the featured plan lifts with a brand glow, cards tilt toward the pointer and features stagger in with drawn checks.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: Chat composer whose textarea grows smoothly, sends on Enter and whose send button springs into a stop button while a reply streams.

items.name: prompt-suggestion
items.title: Prompt Suggestion
items.description: Suggested prompts as chips or cards that stagger in, lift on hover and press with a spring.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Step-by-step questionnaire: options stagger in, steps slide, progress animates; keyboard friendly.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: Compares qualities across spokes; shapes unfold in sequence and hovering a shape or legend item brings it forward.

items.name: radial-chart
items.title: Radial Chart
items.description: Progress rings or a half gauge; arcs sweep to their value while the center number counts up, and hovering a ring focuses it.

items.name: radio-button-group
items.title: Radio Button Group
items.description: Radio cards and buttons with a sliding selection ring and springy indicator.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star rating: stars pop and fill on hover and select, with half-star display.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panel groups (react-resizable-panels) with animated collapse and a handle that grows on drag.

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich Text Editor
items.description: Lightweight rich text editor with an animated toolbar, bubble menu and live word count.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll area (Radix) with fading edge shadows and scrollbars that appear on hover.

items.name: segment
items.title: Segment
items.description: A segmented control for switching views or values; the thumb slides between options on a spring and arrow keys move the selection.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select (Radix) that pops from the trigger with staggered options and a sliding highlight; supports multiple.

items.name: sheet-pro
items.title: Sheet (sides & parts)
items.description: Left or right panels with a sticky header, scrolling body and footer: the panel slides in on a spring, fields stagger up and dividers fade in as the body scrolls; drag to dismiss.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet & Drawer
items.description: Side panels and bottom drawers that slide in on a spring over a fading scrim, and can be dragged or swiped away to dismiss.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Primary app navigation: the active selection and its signal rail slide between items, and the bar springs into an icon rail with labels fading out.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range slider and progress bar; thumbs grow while dragging, a value bubble pops up and progress springs to its value.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Sonner-style toasts: a <Toaster /> plus an imperative toast() API with types, actions and promise toasts. Toasts stack with depth, fan out on hover, pause while read, swipe away and morph their icon from loading to done.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a multi-step flow: bars fill on a spring with a shimmer on the current step, and completed steps draw their checkmarks.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch whose thumb springs across the track and stretches while pressed.

items.name: table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Semantic table with the Facet cut, numeric alignment and selection. Rows stagger in, highlight on hover, glide to their new place when sorted, and sort arrows morph and flip.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between views of the same context: the underline or pill indicator slides between tabs on a spring and panels fade up.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: Loading text with an animated gradient sweep in neutral or brand colours; stops under reduced motion.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea that grows smoothly with content and an animated character counter.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Activity Timeline & Notifications
items.description: Chronological activity and a notification inbox; items stagger in, connectors draw down between nodes, the current step pulses, and read/dismissed notifications pop their dot and collapse.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Lightweight toaster (provider + useToast hook) for transient confirmations. Toasts stack like a deck, fan out on hover, pause while read, update in place and swipe away.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state buttons and toggle groups. Pressed surfaces scale in and the single-select pill slides between items.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: An agent's step list with timings and collapsible input/output; steps stagger in, icons morph from spinner to a drawn check and the rail fills as steps finish.

items.name: trend-chip
items.title: Trend Chip
items.description: A small change indicator with arrow, sign and tone. The arrow flips and the value rolls when the trend changes.

items.name: widget
items.title: Widget
items.description: Dashboard container with a soft shell, header, legend and an elevated content area for charts, tables or KPIs. Widgets rise in on view and stagger inside a widget grid.

items.name: all
items.title: Everything
items.description: Every Facet UI React component in one command.
